about: The routing replay set (04-chat §3, roadmap 3.4): 50 messages to a home-renovation Space with five topics. Each message lists the outcomes that count as right: route to one of the topics, create a new topic, or answer in Main. `as` names a topic the message should create; later messages refer to it as @name, whatever title the organizer gave it. Acceptance: at least 90% right.

space.name: Home renovation
space.instructions: We're renovating our flat: kitchen, bathroom and some new furniture. Keep answers practical and short.

topics.title: Kitchen layout
topics.brief: Where everything goes in the kitchen: sink, appliances, island, storage, lighting.

topics.title: Contractors
topics.brief: Who does what and when: quotes, scheduling, payments terms and problems with trades.

topics.title: Budget
topics.brief: The overall money: what's been spent, what's planned, what's left.

topics.title: Bathroom
topics.brief: The bathroom redo: shower, tiles, fixtures, ventilation.
